title: Starter Ritual and 10-Day Skills Capsule
contents:
Purpose:
A compact, low-friction onboarding capsule for engineering and product ICs that prioritizes early autonomy, psychological safety, and measurable skill checkpoints across the first 10 calendar days. Designed to be used when hiring velocity is high and managers need a repeatable, lightweight "starter ritual" that reduces noise and accelerates contribution while preserving focus on core first-week goals.

Scope / When to use:
- New ICs (IC2-IC5) in Eng, Product, SRE.
- Hybrid remote-first teams.
- Use as default for hires where role is not heavily compliance-gated (separate flows for restricted data/air-gapped).

Success signals (end of day 10):
- New hire can run the dev test suite and submit a small, reviewed PR that addresses a clear bug or doc gap.
- Buddy/manager have 3 alignment check-ins logged (async notes acceptable).
- New hire completed security & infra access checklist and can connect to staging services.
- Self-reported confidence >= 3/5 on core role responsibilities (quick pulse).

High-level flow (owner = hiring manager):
1) Pre-day0: invite to "starter ritual" Slack channel; checklist emailed; calendar with buddy meetings and 1:1s.
2) Day0–Day3: low-friction environment setup, product orientation, tiny ticket assignment.
3) Day4–Day7: hands-on pairing, first small PR, intro to observability & cost dashboards.
4) Day8–Day10: independent work, retrospective & skill-gap mini-review, confirm access and escalation paths.

Manager checklist (pre-day0):
- Add new hire to starter ritual Slack channel.
- Assign buddy and confirm buddy calendar slots (0.5h/day D0–D4, 1h D6).
- Create one scoped starter ticket (<=4h) with clear acceptance criteria.
- Verify licenses (jetbrains/github/private repos), team org invites, and org chart intro email scheduled.
- Set up 1:1 cadence: weekly for first 30 days.

Buddy checklist (D0–D7):
- D0: run through quick orientation script (~30m): team mission, stack map, release cadence, where to find runbooks.
- D1: pair on running local dev + tests, watch for tooling gaps.
- D2: show debugging path for a common flaky test / service.
- D3: pair to open starter ticket; mentor on PR hygiene.
- D4: lighten pairing; provide list of 3 reading links (code owners, architecture sketch, recent incident).
- D6: review independent PR; provide targeted feedback.

Security & infra quick-gates (must be completed by D3):
- MFA enabled and recovery keys recorded.
- VPN/VPC access verified (if applicable).
- Staging credentials rotated and confirmed.
- Approval recorded in access spreadsheet (people-ops owner: Asha Patel).

10-day schedule (practical daily plan):
- Day0 (onboarding day): HR + People Ops basics (pay, benefits link); Slack intro; buddy 30m; dev laptop preconfigured notes; calendar overview.
- Day1: Local dev env + tests (buddy); tiny ticket assigned; README walk; async: update status in starter ritual channel.
- Day2: Pair debugging session; meet product partner (15m intro); infra checklist.
- Day3: Submit first draft PR for tiny ticket; security checklist sign-off.
- Day4: Review feedback, iterate PR; demo short walkthrough to buddy.
- Day5: Focused reading day (architecture + runbooks); 1:1 with manager (30m) to sync goals.
- Day6: Independent work window; buddy deep-dive scheduled (1h).
- Day7: Stabilize changes; observability intro (how to read traces/logs, SLOs).
- Day8: Cross-team intro session (15m per stakeholder) scheduled; make improvement to docs or tests.
- Day9: Finalize and merge starter PR; prepare 10-day retrospective notes.
- Day10: 10-day retro with manager + buddy (30m): capture blockers, confidence pulse, next 30-day aims.

Mini hiring plan (if backfill needed during starter capsule):
- Role snapshot for quick postings (1-paragraph): core responsibility, must-have tech, success in first 90 days. Keep postings short to drive quality over quantity.
- Screening quick-probes (phone screen 20m): 3 behavioral + 2 focused tech probes (ask candidate to sketch a debugging approach; ask about a time they shipped a small performance fix).
- Interview rubric (compact):
  * Signal tiers: 3 = strong hire, 2 = borderline (needs paired hire), 1 = not right now.
  * Criteria (each 1–3): problem decomposition, shipping bias (past 6 months), communication (async), role-fit basics.
  * Hiring decision: average >=2.6 -> proceed; 2.0–2.6 -> hiring manager calibrates with team; <2 -> pass.

Sample evaluation note template (use in ATS or as doc):
- Candidate: [name]
- Role: [role]
- Screen date: [YYYY-MM-DD]
- Notes: bullet list (what impressed, gaps)
- Recommendation: [tier 3/2/1] with 1-line rationale

10-day retro guide (manager-run):
- Start: 5m framing (purpose of capsule).
- New hire: 10m walkthrough — what worked, biggest blocker.
- Buddy: 5m notes on handoff readiness.
- Manager: 5m next 30-day priorities and any training suggested.
- Pulse: quick 1–5 confidence rating recorded in the new-hire tracking sheet.

Low-friction eval checks (signals to flag for remediation):
- Failure to run tests after 3 pairing sessions -> schedule dedicated tooling slot and escalate to infra.
- Repeated access failures -> treat as onboarding blocker; pause non-critical work until resolved.
- Low communication (missed syncs and no async updates) -> manager intervention and explicit expectations.

Notes to people-ops:
- Keep the starter ticket templates centralized (people-ops library).
- Track metrics monthly: percent of hires meeting 10-day success signals, avg days to first PR, average number of buddy sessions.
- Run quarterly calibration with hiring managers to refine rubric thresholds and starter ticket sizing.

Appendix: quick starter ticket template (copyable):
- Title: [starter] short desc
- Context: why this matters (1–2 lines)
- Acceptance: steps to verify, tests to run, perf/behaviour expectations
- Est time: 2–4 hours
- Owner: new hire + buddy reviewer

This capsule is intentionally terse — the goal is repeatability and low cognitive overhead. Use it as default for roles that benefit from early hands-on work; adapt for compliance-heavy hires with additional gating steps.

Unresolved questions / follow-ups:
- Should we add a mandatory 1-hour "observability tour" for DB-heavy roles? (suggested: yes for infra adjacent hires).
- People-ops to propose a quarterly report template for starter-capsule outcomes.
